bounds.quote: Drive the hips forward to return to tall kneeling; when the ribs flare, shorten the range.

bounds.quote: Clean and press one kettlebell overhead, lock the elbow, and use the free arm forward as a counterbalance. Root the whole foot and sit between the hips while keeping the bell stacked over the shoulder and the eyes forward.
